title: SWAP Core Architecture Invariant Audit for Restricted Fixed-Weir Balance Readiness

invariants.name: one computational kernel
invariants.application: fixed-weir balance is a reusable process contract, not a separate SWAP version

invariants.name: kernel separated from IO
invariants.application: management-period parsing and legacy .dra IO remain outside the process

invariants.name: explicit data separation
invariants.application: parameters, S state, upstream transfers, numerical solve policy and results are distinct

invariants.name: compact persistent state
invariants.application: SWMAN=1 requires only secondary storage S; WLS and target levels are derived

invariants.name: scratch per worker
invariants.application: root brackets and rating intermediates are trial scratch, not column state

invariants.name: scalable memory layout
invariants.application: prepared storage/rating parameters are immutable and batchable; no solver object per column required

invariants.name: transactional timesteps
invariants.application: D4 returns trial S1 and fluxes; D6 owns atomic commit or rollback

invariants.name: cheap recomputation and warm start
invariants.application: fixed-weir trial is deterministic from committed S0 and interval inputs; bracket guesses may be reused numerically

invariants.name: generic time
invariants.application: equations use arbitrary positive dt; calendar management-period resolution is external

invariants.name: flexible coupling windows
invariants.application: no midnight or one-day assumption; control events may subdivide any window

invariants.name: coupling first-class
invariants.application: trial/rollback and explicit accepted transfers are preserved for later runtime coupling

invariants.name: explicit groundwater interface contract
invariants.application: D4 does not alter the groundwater coupling contract and consumes drainage transfer as an upstream result

invariants.name: mass conservation absolute
invariants.application: S1 uses the same q_supply and q_discharge published to the mass ledger; no mass tolerance or floor concession

invariants.name: interface sensitivities first-class
invariants.application: power-rating derivative and crest singularity are explicit; unavailable tangent never erases physical flux

invariants.name: limit coupling costs
invariants.application: monotone scalar bracketed solve is bounded and does not require repeated full SWAP runs

invariants.name: MultiSWAP primary use case
invariants.application: stateless trial evaluator plus compact S state supports batched many-column execution

invariants.name: no mandatory one-to-one MODFLOW relation
invariants.application: surface-water balance knows no MODFLOW cell fractions or tile topology

invariants.name: deep-vadose optional separate component
invariants.application: D4 has no deep-vadose responsibility

invariants.name: mass-conserving component transitions
invariants.application: all D4 transfers are explicit signed flux/volume terms and cannot disappear during composition

invariants.name: alternative soil-water solvers remain open
invariants.application: D4 consumes process transfers and is independent of Richards implementation

invariants.name: reuse SWAP physics maximally
invariants.application: frozen fixed-weir equations are reconstructed without legacy globals/module boundaries

invariants.name: other modules not coupled to HeadCalc internals
invariants.application: D4 requires no HeadCalc arrays or solver internals

invariants.name: physics options and solver policy separated
invariants.application: SWQHR=1 physics is separate from root tolerance, bracketing budget, WLSBAK and dt-reduction policy

invariants.name: predictable compute time
invariants.application: reference route is a bounded monotone scalar solve with explicit infeasibility and retry status

invariants.name: reference mode available
invariants.application: source-equation bracketed reference route is retained; no throughput approximation is admitted here

invariants.name: diagnostics part of runtime
invariants.application: branch, overflow/infeasibility, root residual, tangent availability and solver cost are required outputs

invariants.name: optional functionality scales with use
invariants.application: surface-water state/scratch exists only for SWSEC=2 columns using this route

invariants.name: runtime/coupler organizes composition
invariants.application: D3 limiter, D4 balance, D2 exchange and D6 transaction ordering stay separately owned

invariants.name: no silent dependencies
invariants.application: no file, midnight, daily-step or direct MODFLOW assumption is present

invariants.name: every architecture change audited
invariants.application: this artifact explicitly audits all 30 invariants and binds nine source-risk holds

hard_holds: legacy 0.001-cm bisection result must not be admitted as mutually consistent S/WLS state
mass residual may never be relaxed to satisfy a rating/root tolerance
beta<1 crest tangent is singular and may not be silently regularized
overflow/no-feasible-rating cases fail closed or request bounded retry
SWQHR=2 and automatic management remain outside D4
